official.deadline_note: Reception of applications opened on 23 February 2026 at 20:00 local time and closes on 28 November 2026 at 23:59 local time. Where the call provides an inconsistencies period, requirements may also be satisfied then.
official.status_note: The SECIHTI call page lists the status of the call as 'Abierta', with the period for 2026 and a reception window from 23 February 2026 20:00 to 28 November 2026 23:59 local CDMX time.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The award is a monthly economic support (apoyo economico mensual) set by the Tabulador de Becas Nacionales 2026; no tuition fee coverage is published.
benefits: Monthly economic support (apoyo economico mensual) set by the Tabulador de Becas Nacionales 2026.
Medical service through ISSSTE, registered as a beneficiary (derechohabiente).
The payment of the scholarship covers intermediate periods that include holidays, and the first payment includes retroactivity to the start of the scholarship.
eligibility: Mexican nationality, or foreign nationals resident in Mexico.
Enrolled in a full-time (escolarizado) postgraduate programme registered in the Sistema Nacional de Posgrados (SNP) and eligible for scholarship allocation.
Prior SECIHTI or CONAHCyT scholarship holders must have completed the conclusion formalities of the previous award before registering a new application.
Must hold a valid Clave Unica de Registro de Poblacion (CURP); foreign nationals use the CURP on their temporary resident card and must keep it valid.
Must satisfy all requirements at the time of the ordinary application period, or apply during the inconsistencies period if the call provides one.
requirements: Create, update or validate the CVU (curriculum vitae) in the Perfil Unico at https://rizoma.secihti.mx/.
Register and submit the scholarship application following the Guia para la postulacion de Becas Nacionales.
Sign the application electronically with the CURP e-signature.
Register a bank account (Guia para el Registro de Cuenta Bancaria BNP).
Complete the procedural steps in the Apeiron system after an award is assigned.
documents: CURP for Mexican citizens, or the CURP contained in the temporary resident card for foreign nationals.
CVU generated in the Perfil Unico.
Evidence of registration in the postgraduate programme (the SNP registry record).
Prior CONAHCyT or SECIHTI completion or non-debt letter where applicable (Carta de Reconocimiento or Carta de No Adeudo).
Guia para Descarga Carta del ISSSTE for the medical service registration.
selection_criteria: Selection is carried out by SECIHTI over two periods of applicant eligibility.
Proposals are evaluated against the eligibility rules published in the call and its Terminos de Referencia.
coverage: Monthly economic support set by the Tabulador de Becas Nacionales 2026, based on the Unidad de Medida y Actualizacion (UMA): Doctorado 6.0 UMA = 21,397.32 MXN per month from 1 February 2026; Maestria and academic exchange 4.5 UMA = 16,047.99 MXN; Especialidad 4.0 UMA = 14,264.88 MXN.
Medical service through ISSSTE as a registered beneficiary.
No tuition coverage and no travel allowance are published.
application_method: Create, update or validate the CVU in the Perfil Unico at https://rizoma.secihti.mx/.
Register and submit the scholarship request electronically with the CURP e-signature during the published window.
After an award is assigned, complete formalisation, sign the electronic documents and register the bank account in Apeiron.
official.application_route: Apply electronically through the Rizoma Perfil Unico with the CURP e-signature, then formalise in Apeiron after an award is assigned.
official.study_mode: Full-time (escolarizado) for the main call; applicants enrolled in non-schooled (no escolarizados) eligible programmes are covered by the parallel Terminos de Referencia B and its separate postulation guides.
official.citizenship_residency: Mexican nationality, or foreign nationals resident in Mexico holding a valid CURP on their temporary resident card.
official.international_eligibility: Foreign nationals legally resident in Mexico are eligible, provided they hold the CURP on a valid temporary resident card.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: The programme must be registered in the Sistema Nacional de Posgrados (SNP) and be eligible for scholarship allocation.
official.duration: Full length of the registered postgraduate programme in complete months, without exceeding the maximum term set in the scholarship regulation.
official.description: The Convocatoria de Becas Nacionales para Estudios de Posgrado 2026, issued by the Secretaria de Ciencia, Humanidades, Tecnologia e Innovacion (SECIHTI), provides monthly economic support and ISSSTE medical service to students enrolled in postgraduate programmes registered in the Sistema Nacional de Posgrados.
official.english_requirement: Spanish. The call, the guides and the Rizoma and Apeiron systems are published in Spanish only.

not_confirmed: funding_amount as a single value - the Tabulador de Becas Nacionales 2026 sets three level-dependent amounts (Doctorado 21,397.32, Maestria and academic exchange 16,047.99, Especialidad 14,264.88 MXN per month), so the recorded figure is the master's level and the doctoral figure is 21,397.32 MXN
tuition_coverage and travel_coverage - the published award is a monthly economic support plus ISSSTE medical service, with no tuition or travel coverage stated
research_requirement - the call page and supporting information documents publish no research-proposal requirement
verification.notes: The SECIHTI call page and the official Tabulador de Becas Nacionales 2026 PDF on secihti.mx were read in full. The 23 February to 28 November 2026 application window, the three UMA-based monthly amounts tied to the 2026 UMA of 3,566.22 MXN, the retroactive first payment covering holiday periods, and the Rizoma, Apeiron and ISSSTE routes were all confirmed on the awarding body's own domain.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a monthly stipend tied to the UMA and to your study level, so the number you should budget with is 16,047.99 MXN a month for a master's and 21,397.32 MXN for a doctorate, not a single figure - and it is refreshed against the February UMA each year for the life of the award. It does not pay tuition, so if your programme charges colegiatura you need another source. The application itself is fully administrative: what sinks applications is an out-of-date CVU, an unsigned CURP e-signature or a missing SNP registration record, not a weak research idea. The window closes on 28 November 2026 at 23:59 local time.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Mexican citizens, or foreign nationals legally resident in Mexico, already enrolled in a full-time master's or doctoral programme registered in the Sistema Nacional de Posgrados.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your programme is registered in the Sistema Nacional de Posgrados and appears on the eligible-programme list for this call.
Update and validate your CVU in the Perfil Unico at rizoma.secihti.mx before the window closes, and have your SNP registration record and official photo identification ready as separate files.
If you held a previous CONAHCyT or SECIHTI scholarship, complete its conclusion formalities first and obtain the Carta de Reconocimiento or Carta de No Adeudo.
Check that your CURP is valid; foreign nationals must keep the CURP on their temporary resident card valid.
Sign the application electronically with your CURP e-signature - an unsigned file is not a submission.
After an award is assigned, work through the formalisation guides and register your bank account in Apeiron.
common_rejection_risks: Applying while a previous SECIHTI or CONAHCyT scholarship is still not formally concluded.
A programme that is not registered in the SNP or is not on the eligible list for this call.
An invalid or outdated CURP, especially for foreign nationals whose temporary resident card has expired.
An application left unsigned with the CURP e-signature.
Missing the inconsistency window if you did not meet every requirement during the ordinary period.
For non-schooled (no escolarizado) programmes, applying under the escolarizado rules instead of the parallel Terminos de Referencia B.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition fees are not covered, and no travel allowance is published. The award is a monthly stipend plus ISSSTE medical service, so enrolment fees, materials and any study-related travel must be met from other income.
document_audit: The CVU lives in the Perfil Unico at rizoma.secihti.mx and must be created, updated or validated - an abandoned draft CVU is the most common silent failure.
Evidence of registration must be the SNP registry record, not a general enrolment letter from the university.
The Carta de Reconocimiento or Carta de No Adeudo is needed from your previous institution or funder, and it takes time to obtain.
The ISSSTE letter is generated through its own guide (Guia para Descarga Carta del ISSSTE) rather than issued automatically.
Bank account registration happens in Apeiron after the award, guided by the Guia para el Registro de Cuenta Bancaria BNP.
alerts: Applications close on 28 November 2026 at 23:59 local Mexico City time; the window opened on 23 February 2026 at 20:00.
The monthly amount is recalculated each February against the UMA in force, so a figure fixed at application time will drift over the life of the scholarship.
The first payment includes retroactivity to the start of the scholarship, and payments continue through intermediate periods that include holidays.
The call, the guides and both the Rizoma and Apeiron systems are Spanish-only, so budget time for that if Spanish is not your working language.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: You build and validate your CVU in Rizoma, submit the request with your CURP e-signature before 28 November 2026, SECIHTI assesses eligibility over two periods, and if you are awarded you then complete formalisation, electronic signature and bank account registration in Apeiron.
